settings.title: Profile Travel: how to plan this Aidreamcapes video theme workflow
settings.summary: Use this Aidreamcapes guide to decide when Profile Travel fits, which source frames or references help, what to compare before spending credits, and how to review finished images privately.
settings.author: Aidreamcapes editorial team
settings.imageAlt: Aidreamcapes Profile Travel video theme category cover
settings.body:
The Profile Travel video theme category has a specific job inside Aidreamcapes: Creator, solo, and personal-atlas travel profile clips. It works best when the request has one clear use, a small set of dependable source frames, and a private review plan before anything is downloaded or shared.

When Profile Travel is the right fit

Use Profile Travel when a still image or ordered frame set needs a short motion direction instead of another still-image gallery. This is the category to choose when Profile Travel, profile-travel, private video clips, and source frames match the result you want from the next video clip. If the goal is still vague, start by naming the final use: profile update, creator album, keepsake, announcement, social draft, or a short motion test.

The strongest profile travel requests keep style and purpose in the same lane. A customer who needs a calm work portrait should not judge the same set by the standards of a dramatic scene package. A customer who wants a themed private album should allow more mood, but still check whether the person remains recognizable.

What to prepare before choosing it

Choose clean source frames, define one motion idea, and make sure the image is already worth animating before spending credits. Treat the source frames as identity evidence first. Style references, outfit notes, destination cues, fan details, or movement ideas should support the request after the person is already clear.

For a first pass, keep the input set smaller and cleaner than a social camera roll. Use current images, avoid heavy filters, and separate unrelated goals into different private jobs. Aidreamcapes can follow a focused brief more reliably than a folder that asks for several looks at once.

How to compare Profile Travel with nearby choices

Compare profile travel against neighboring video themes by the decision it helps you make, not only by which cover image looks strongest. The table below turns the category into a practical choice before credit cost is confirmed.

Decision pointUse Profile Travel whenReview after generation
Final useUse Profile Travel when a still image or ordered frame set needs a short motion direction instead of another still-image gallery.Review face stability, frame crop, background movement, hand and hair edges, and whether the clip still fits the original image goal.
source framesChoose clean source frames, define one motion idea, and make sure the image is already worth animating before spending credits.Check whether the clearest input details carried through the best images.
Category examplesProfile Travel, profile-travel, private video clips, and source framesKeep the outputs that match the chosen example instead of mixing several directions.
Credit planUse a focused first pass when the style is new.Decide whether the next request should repeat, expand, or change direction.

Credit and private gallery planning

Before the job starts, review the visible credit cost and ask whether the category is carrying the right amount of work. If you only need to test profile travel, a smaller request can teach you what works. If the final use is already clear, a broader gallery may be easier to judge because it gives more crops and expressions to compare.

Finished outputs belong in the signed-in private gallery first. Use that space to compare identity, crop, expression, background detail, and whether the video theme category actually delivered the mood you selected. Download favorites only after separating public-use images from experiments.

Details to review before download

Review face stability, frame crop, background movement, hand and hair edges, and whether the clip still fits the original image goal. Also check small visual details that often decide whether a result is ready for a profile, card, post, or archive: face consistency, hand and hair edges, clothing lines, background distractions, and whether the image still reads well at the crop size where you will use it.

Profile Travel adds pacing to the image story, so motion direction, camera rhythm, and crop stability matter as much as style. This is where Profile Travel becomes more than a menu label. The visible mood should explain why the category was chosen, while the private gallery keeps the customer in control of what stays personal and what becomes a downloaded favorite.

Mistakes to avoid

Avoid using Profile Travel to fix weak source frames; identity, crop, and background detail should be reviewed before animation. The fastest way to weaken profile travel results is to overload the request with unrelated goals. Do not ask one job to be a professional portrait, a themed album, a restoration pass, and a motion concept at the same time. Keep the category honest, then run a second request when the next direction is different enough to need its own review.

A planning pass before you spend credits

  • Name the exact use for the finished images.
  • Choose the clearest source frames before adding style references.
  • Match the request to Profile Travel, profile-travel, private video clips, and source frames, not every nearby category.
  • Review credit cost before generation starts.
  • Use the private gallery to compare results before downloading favorites.

For broader browsing, open Tools and compare Profile Travel with the categories around it. The best choice is the one that makes the review criteria obvious before the first image is generated.

Profile Travel FAQ

Profile Travel questions usually come down to source quality, scope, credit planning, and whether the finished images match the intended use.

Is Profile Travel good for a first request?

Yes, if the intended use is clear and the source frames are current, sharp, and permission-safe. If you are testing a dramatic change, start narrower so the first private gallery can show whether the direction deserves a larger credit spend.

How many source frames should I prepare?

Use enough images to show identity, angle, and expression without adding confusion. A small set of clear portraits usually beats a large group of old, filtered, or mixed-purpose images.

When should I choose another category instead?

Choose another category when the review criteria change. If Profile Travel is being judged by a different use case, style world, or motion need, split the work into a separate private job so credits support a clearer outcome.

Profile Travel works best when it is treated as a focused planning choice. Prepare the right inputs, review the cost, and let the private gallery show what should happen next.

settings.title: KIDS Act
settings.body:
1. Service audience

Aidreamcapes is not directed to children under 13 and is not designed for child account creation. Customers should use the service only if they can lawfully manage an account or have permission from a parent or legal guardian.

2. COPPA-aware handling

The Children's Online Privacy Protection Act (COPPA) applies to certain online services directed to children under 13 or knowingly collecting personal information from children under 13. Aidreamcapes does not knowingly collect account information directly from children under 13. If we learn that child personal information was provided without required consent, we will review and delete or restrict it as appropriate.

3. Photos of minors

Customers must not upload photos of minors unless they are the parent, legal guardian, or otherwise have the legal right and consent to use those images for the requested AI workflow. Minor images should never be used for deceptive, exploitative, unlawful, or unsafe purposes.

4. Parent or guardian requests

A parent or legal guardian may contact us to ask about access, deletion, or restriction of child-related information. We may request verification before acting on a sensitive privacy request.

5. CISA requests

California and other U.S. state privacy requests are handled in our CISA notice, including access, deletion, correction, opt-out, and appeal requests where applicable.

6. Contact

Email support@aidreamcapes.com for children's privacy or COPPA-related questions.

settings.title: Aidreamcapes FAQ
settings.subtitle: Answers about source photos, travel package choice, credits, privacy, delivery, and refunds.
settings.journeyDescriptions: Add clear source photos.|Pick a travel direction.|Spend visible credits.|Review the private gallery.

settings.question: Which source photos work best for Aidreamcapes?
settings.answer: Use recent, clear portraits with natural expressions, varied angles, and minimal filters. Add outfit or destination references when the package needs a specific travel feeling.

settings.question: How should I choose a travel package?
settings.answer: Start with the final use: Route Portrait Albums for a broad scene atlas, Coastal Light Sets for sea light, Old Quarter Walks for city texture, Alpine Trail Frames for open-air depth, and Postcard Story Sets for share-ready crops.

settings.question: Are Aidreamcapes uploads and galleries private?
settings.answer: Yes. Source photos, generation jobs, albums, credit records, and downloads stay connected to the signed-in customer account.

settings.question: When are credits spent?
settings.answer: Credits are visible before a request starts. A job reserves the needed credits first, successful results consume them, and failed requests can release them.

settings.question: Where do finished portraits arrive?
settings.answer: Finished travel portraits return to the private account gallery so customers can compare crops, download favorites, and decide what to share.

settings.question: Can unused credits be reviewed?
settings.answer: Unused purchased credits can be reviewed under the refund policy. Credits spent on successful generation jobs are generally not refundable.

settings.question: What remains after a plan is canceled?
settings.answer: Customers can keep access to existing private albums according to the site's account rules, while new premium requests may require an active plan or available credits.

settings.title: Privacy policy
settings.body:
1. Information we collect

Aidreamcapes collects the information needed to operate a private AI portrait workspace: account email, authentication state, source photos, reference notes, package selections, prompts, generation settings, credit ledger events, checkout status, support messages, generated outputs, downloads, and basic device or request metadata used for security and reliability.

2. How we use information

We use this information to create requested travel portraits, reserve and settle credits, deliver private galleries, keep account history accurate, provide support, prevent misuse, troubleshoot failed jobs, improve source-photo guidance, and show the right workspace pages after sign-in.

3. Source photos and generated images

Uploads and generated results stay tied to the current Aidreamcapes site and signed-in customer account. They are not sold as stock images, published in public galleries, or transferred to unrelated storefronts by default. Infrastructure and AI providers may process files only as needed to complete the service requested by the customer.

4. Payments, credits, and retention

Payments are handled by a connected payment provider. Aidreamcapes stores order IDs, checkout status, subscription state, credit purchases, reservations, reversals, and refund records; it does not store full card numbers on its own servers. Account records and generated assets are retained while needed for delivery, support, compliance, security, and customer access.

5. Customer choices and contact

Customers can contact support to ask about access, deletion, correction, privacy review, or account-specific delivery questions. Email support@aidreamcapes.com and include the account email plus any relevant order, job, or gallery details so the request can be reviewed safely.

settings.title: Refund policy
settings.body:
1. Refund eligibility

Refund requests are reviewed based on credit use, checkout status, subscription state, and whether generation work has already been completed. Unused one-time credit purchases may be eligible for review within the stated support window, while credits already consumed by successful travel generations are generally not refundable.

2. Failed or interrupted jobs

If a service-side technical failure prevents generation or private gallery delivery, Aidreamcapes may release reserved credits, rerun the request, provide troubleshooting, or review a refund. Support may ask for the account email, package name, job status, approximate request time, and any error message shown in the workspace.

3. Subscriptions and renewals

Canceling a subscription stops future renewals but does not automatically refund credits already granted or spent. Subscription refunds depend on payment status, usage, local requirements, and whether credits from the billing period have been applied to completed generations.

4. Non-refundable cases

Refunds are usually not available for dissatisfaction caused by unclear source photos, unsupported requests, changed creative preferences after generation, or outputs that were delivered according to the selected package. Customers should review source-photo guidance before starting a package run.

5. How to request review

Email support@aidreamcapes.com with the Aidreamcapes account email, checkout reference if available, package or job details, and a short explanation. Support will review the ledger and delivery records before deciding whether to release credits, rerun work, or refund eligible payments.

settings.title: Digital delivery
settings.body:
1. No physical shipping

Aidreamcapes sells digital AI travel portrait credits, generated image packages, downloads, and private gallery access. We do not ship physical products, printed photos, USB drives, or mailed merchandise from this storefront.

2. Digital delivery

Credits are added after payment confirmation. Generated images are delivered inside the signed-in customer workspace or private gallery when a job completes. Delivery timing can vary based on source photo quality, selected package settings, provider availability, moderation review, and system load.

3. Failed or delayed jobs

If a service-side issue prevents delivery, Aidreamcapes may release reserved credits, rerun the job, troubleshoot the account, or review refund eligibility under the refund policy. Support may ask for the account email, package name, order details, and job status.

4. No carrier tracking or customs

Because orders are digital, customers do not receive carrier tracking numbers and are not charged shipping, customs, duties, or physical handling fees by Aidreamcapes.

5. Contact

Email support@aidreamcapes.com with the Aidreamcapes account email, order or job details, and a short description if a digital delivery does not appear in the workspace.

settings.title: Studio Terms
settings.body:
1. Acceptance

By using Aidreamcapes, creating an account, purchasing credits, uploading source photos, starting a generation job, or opening a private gallery, you agree to these terms and the privacy policy that governs account data, uploads, payment status, and delivery records.

2. Accounts and security

Customers must provide accurate account information, keep sign-in credentials secure, and use the service only for lawful personal, creator, or business workflows. Each account is scoped to its site customer record and should not be shared in a way that bypasses billing, moderation, or privacy controls.

3. Credits, packages, and delivery

Credits are granted after confirmed payment, displayed before package creation, reserved when a job starts, consumed after successful delivery, and released when a request fails or times out. Delivery times, output counts, and creative results can vary based on source-photo quality, package settings, provider availability, and safety review.

4. Uploaded content and rights

You may only upload portraits, travel references, wardrobe notes, or route direction that you own or have permission to use. You remain responsible for the source material you submit and for how you use generated outputs. Aidreamcapes may reject, remove, or restrict requests that violate law, policy, platform safety rules, or third-party rights.

5. Service limits and changes

Aidreamcapes may update packages, pricing, credit rules, workflows, providers, delivery limits, or safety practices to keep the service reliable. We may pause or limit access when needed for security, abuse prevention, maintenance, payment issues, or policy enforcement.

6. Contact

Email support@aidreamcapes.com for account, billing, privacy, refund, policy, generation, or private gallery questions. Include the account email and relevant job or order details when requesting support.

settings.title: Content policy
settings.body:
1. Allowed uploads

Upload only portraits, product references, wardrobe notes, location inspiration, or creative direction that you own, created, licensed, or have permission to use. Source photos should be clear enough to support identity-safe travel escape portraits and should not include people who have not consented to the intended use.

2. Disallowed requests

Do not use Aidreamcapes for impersonation, harassment, explicit exploitation, non-consensual imagery, illegal activity, stolen images, hateful or abusive content, deceptive identity use, attempts to bypass moderation, or requests involving protected marks or people in a misleading way.

3. Generated outputs

AI results may contain artifacts, inaccurate details, unexpected styling, or visual assumptions. Customers should review final images before using them publicly, commercially, or in identity-sensitive contexts. Generated results should not be presented as factual documentary evidence of events that did not happen.

4. Review and enforcement

Aidreamcapes may block prompts, reject uploads, pause jobs, remove outputs, release credits, or restrict accounts when content appears unsafe, unauthorized, abusive, unlawful, or outside supported package intent. Support may request more context when a request is ambiguous.

5. Reporting concerns

Email support@aidreamcapes.com to report content concerns, suspected misuse, account access issues, or generated output that needs review. Include the account email, job details, and a concise description of the concern.

settings.title: Cookie policy
settings.body:
1. Essential cookies and local storage

Aidreamcapes uses essential cookies and local storage to support sign-in, session security, checkout continuity, cart state, credit visibility, account preferences, private workspace routing, and customer-only gallery access. Some features may not work correctly if this storage is blocked or cleared.

2. Security and reliability signals

We may use limited operational signals such as request metadata, error state, device or browser type, and performance timing to detect failed requests, protect accounts, diagnose delivery issues, and improve site reliability. These signals are used to operate the service rather than to sell personal photos.

3. Payment and third-party tools

Checkout, email delivery, analytics, infrastructure, or AI processing providers may set or read cookies and related identifiers when they are necessary for payment status, fraud prevention, service delivery, security, or operational measurement. Their use is limited by the role they perform for the Aidreamcapes workflow.

4. Your choices

You can clear cookies or adjust browser settings at any time. Clearing storage may sign you out, interrupt checkout, remove local preferences, or require you to sign in again before accessing private albums, jobs, credit history, or downloads.

5. Contact

Email support@aidreamcapes.com if you have questions about cookies, account sessions, checkout continuity, or private gallery access on Aidreamcapes.

settings.title: How to plan source photos for cinematic AI travel portraits
settings.summary: Choose clear portraits, route-aware outfit notes, and focused references so Aidreamcapes can build cleaner private destination albums.
settings.author: Aidreamcapes editorial team
settings.imageAlt: Aidreamcapes route portrait album cover
settings.body:
Strong Aidreamcapes results begin before a destination scene is generated. The private workflow needs clear portraits first, then route mood, outfit notes, and atmosphere references that support the album direction without overloading it.

Start with identity clarity

Choose recent portraits where the face is sharp, naturally lit, and easy to recognize. Avoid heavy filters, sunglasses, harsh shadows, and group photos when the request needs consistent solo travel portraits.

For paired or family-style route albums, keep the same rule for every person in the set. One clear portrait for each subject is better than a folder where one person appears in crisp light and another is only visible in distant vacation photos.

Add destination context intentionally

A coastal set may need warm light, linen textures, and relaxed posture notes. An old quarter walk can use cafe, plaza, stone street, and boutique hotel references. A trail album benefits from outdoor layers, weather notes, and preferred season.

Helpful context can also include what should stay out of the scene. If the album should feel like a quiet hotel morning, say that instead of leaving room for nightlife, crowded streets, or heavy fashion styling. Boundaries keep the route believable and make the finished gallery easier to review.

Match wardrobe notes to the route

Wardrobe does not need to be complicated. Light neutrals can work for beach and resort scenes. Structured jackets can fit city routes. Outdoor layers support alpine or road-trip moods. Use wardrobe notes to make the destination believable, not to rewrite every detail of the person.

Keep the request focused

One clear route direction usually works better than five mixed destinations in the same job. If you want both a coastal album and a city album, run them as separate package choices so each private gallery has a coherent mood.

Choose photos for the route, not just the face

A travel portrait needs identity, but it also needs enough body and wardrobe context to feel believable in a destination scene. A close crop can help with face detail, while a half-body source image helps the request understand posture, shoulders, and how clothing should sit in a route album.

If the destination mood involves movement, such as a market walk or trail overlook, include one relaxed standing frame. If the route is more polished, such as a resort balcony or city cafe, a calmer portrait with clean lighting may be enough.

Balance the real person and the place mood

The best Aidreamcapes requests do not let the destination swallow the person. A dramatic coast, old city lane, or alpine overlook should support the portrait rather than turn the subject into a background detail. When choosing source photos, keep one image where the face is unmistakable and one image that shows posture or wardrobe. When writing route notes, describe the place in visible terms instead of asking for a vague travel fantasy.

This balance is especially useful for shared albums or profile refreshes. The image should feel like a believable travel portrait of the person, not an anonymous postcard with a face added later.

Review outputs privately before sharing

Finished travel portraits return to the Aidreamcapes account gallery. Compare identity, lighting, crop, and route consistency before downloading favorites for profiles, postcards, social posts, or personal keepsakes.

Source planning checklist

  • Use clear recent portraits before expressive references.
  • Pick one route mood for the first request.
  • Add outfit notes that support the destination.
  • Check the visible credit cost before generation.
  • Review the private gallery before sharing images elsewhere.

Travel source photo FAQ

Do I need real travel photos?

No. The source photos should mainly identify the person. Destination references and package choice can describe the route mood. Real travel photos can help as references only when you own them and they support the scene clearly.

Should I include full-body photos?

A full-body photo is useful for route albums with walking, overlook, or resort scenes, but it should still be clear and current. If the face becomes too small, pair it with a sharper portrait.

What if my photos have different outfits?

Some variety is fine, but avoid making wardrobe the main signal. Use outfit notes to guide the destination look, then let the clearest current portraits carry identity.

Source planning does not need a professional travel shoot. It needs clear portraits and a route brief that knows what kind of album you want.

seo.title: Politica de privacidad | AIdreamshoots
seo.description: AIdreamshoots explica como protege selfies, pedidos, creditos, albumes privados y solicitudes de datos de clientes.
seo.keywords: AIdreamshoots,politica de privacidad,fotos IA,creditos privados,album digital

settings.body:
1. Informacion que tratamos

AIdreamshoots usa el correo de cuenta, sesiones, selfies fuente, selecciones de paquete, instrucciones creativas, resultados generados, pedidos, suscripciones, movimientos de creditos, mensajes de soporte y senales tecnicas necesarias para seguridad y fiabilidad.

2. Uso de la informacion

Usamos esos datos para crear retratos solicitados, reservar y liquidar creditos, entregar albumes privados, resolver incidencias, prevenir abuso, mejorar guias de fotos fuente y mostrar el espacio privado correcto despues de iniciar sesion.

3. Fotos privadas

Las subidas y resultados quedan ligados a la cuenta del cliente en aidreamshoots.eu. No se venden como imagenes de stock ni se publican en galerias abiertas por defecto.

4. Pagos y conservacion

Los pagos se procesan con un proveedor conectado. Guardamos referencias de pedido, pago, reservas, devoluciones y suscripcion, no numeros completos de tarjeta. Algunos registros se conservan para soporte, seguridad, cumplimiento y acceso del cliente.

5. Opciones del cliente

Puedes pedir acceso, correccion, eliminacion o revision escribiendo a support@aidreamshoots.eu con el correo de la cuenta y el pedido afectado.

settings.subtitle: Como cuidamos cuentas, selfies fuente, creditos, pedidos y albumes privados.

seo.title: Politica de reembolsos | AIdreamshoots
seo.description: Revisa como AIdreamshoots evalua creditos no usados, fallos tecnicos, pedidos entregados y solicitudes de reembolso.
seo.keywords: AIdreamshoots,politica de reembolsos,fotos IA,creditos privados,album digital

settings.body:
1. Elegibilidad

Puedes pedir revision de creditos comprados y no usados cuando no hayan sido reservados, consumidos ni asociados a una generacion completada.

2. Ventana de revision

Envia la solicitud con email de cuenta, pedido y motivo. Revisamos pago, historial de creditos y trabajos de fotos antes de decidir.

3. Creditos usados

Los creditos gastados en paquetes entregados normalmente no son reembolsables porque ya se usaron recursos de proveedor, almacenamiento y entrega.

4. Fallos tecnicos

Si un fallo de AIdreamshoots impide la entrega, soporte puede liberar creditos, reintentar el trabajo, entregar creditos de reemplazo o aprobar reembolso tras revision.

5. Contacto

Escribe a support@aidreamshoots.eu para facturacion o reembolsos.

seo.title: Entrega digital | AIdreamshoots
seo.description: AIdreamshoots entrega resultados digitales dentro de una galeria privada, sin envios fisicos ni mezcla con otros escaparates.
seo.keywords: AIdreamshoots,entrega digital,fotos IA,creditos privados,album digital

settings.body:
1. Sin paquete fisico

AIdreamshoots no envia productos por correo postal. El set terminado, las descargas y los movimientos de creditos viven dentro de la cuenta privada.

2. Donde llega el resultado

Entra con el email usado al comprar o generar para abrir el album, revisar favoritos y descargar archivos disponibles.

3. Plazos variables

La entrega depende del volumen de cola, nitidez de selfies, numero de salidas y respuesta del proveedor de generacion.

4. Si falta una imagen

Escribe a support@aidreamshoots.eu con email de cuenta, paquete elegido y pedido para revisar el estado del set.

seo.title: Terminos de servicio | AIdreamshoots
seo.description: Terminos de AIdreamshoots para cuenta, fotos autorizadas, creditos, paquetes, seguridad y descarga privada.
seo.keywords: AIdreamshoots,terminos de servicio,fotos IA,creditos privados,album digital

settings.body:
1. Aceptacion

Al usar AIdreamshoots, crear cuenta, comprar creditos, subir fotos o iniciar un paquete aceptas estos terminos.

2. Uso permitido

Debes subir imagenes propias o con permiso, usar instrucciones licitas y evitar contenido que vulnere privacidad, identidad, propiedad intelectual o normas de seguridad.

3. Creditos y pedidos

Los creditos se muestran antes de generar. Pueden reservarse, gastarse, liberarse o devolverse segun el estado del pedido y la politica aplicable.

4. Resultados

Los albumes se entregan digitalmente en la cuenta privada. La calidad depende de fotos fuente, paquete, disponibilidad tecnica y reglas de proveedor.

5. Soporte

Para cuenta, pedidos o terminos, escribe a support@aidreamshoots.eu.

settings.subtitle: Como cuidamos cuentas, selfies fuente, creditos, pedidos y albumes privados.
settings.body: AIdreamshoots es una tienda en espanol para crear retratos profesionales, fotos de pareja y albumes privados con IA desde tus selfies.
settings.tagline: Sets privados de fotos con IA, creditos visibles y galerias seguras.
settings.socialBody: Subidas privadas, creditos visibles, pago claro y entrega dentro de una sola cuenta.
settings.bottomLine: Creditos, generacion y galerias privadas en un solo espacio.

settings.body:
1. Informacion que tratamos

AIdreamshoots usa el correo de cuenta, sesiones, selfies fuente, selecciones de paquete, instrucciones creativas, resultados generados, pedidos, suscripciones, movimientos de creditos, mensajes de soporte y senales tecnicas necesarias para seguridad y fiabilidad.

2. Uso de la informacion

Usamos esos datos para crear retratos solicitados, reservar y liquidar creditos, entregar albumes privados, resolver incidencias, prevenir abuso, mejorar guias de fotos fuente y mostrar el espacio privado correcto despues de iniciar sesion.

3. Fotos privadas

Las subidas y resultados quedan ligados a la cuenta del cliente en aidreamshoots.eu. No se venden como imagenes de stock ni se publican en galerias abiertas por defecto.

4. Pagos y conservacion

Los pagos se procesan con un proveedor conectado. Guardamos referencias de pedido, pago, reservas, devoluciones y suscripcion, no numeros completos de tarjeta. Algunos registros se conservan para soporte, seguridad, cumplimiento y acceso del cliente.

5. Opciones del cliente

Puedes pedir acceso, correccion, eliminacion o revision escribiendo a support@aidreamshoots.eu con el correo de la cuenta y el pedido afectado.

settings.body:
1. Aceptacion

Al usar AIdreamshoots, crear cuenta, comprar creditos, subir fotos o iniciar un paquete aceptas estos terminos.

2. Uso permitido

Debes subir imagenes propias o con permiso, usar instrucciones licitas y evitar contenido que vulnere privacidad, identidad, propiedad intelectual o normas de seguridad.

3. Creditos y pedidos

Los creditos se muestran antes de generar. Pueden reservarse, gastarse, liberarse o devolverse segun el estado del pedido y la politica aplicable.

4. Resultados

Los albumes se entregan digitalmente en la cuenta privada. La calidad depende de fotos fuente, paquete, disponibilidad tecnica y reglas de proveedor.

5. Soporte

Para cuenta, pedidos o terminos, escribe a support@aidreamshoots.eu.

settings.body:
1. Subidas permitidas

Sube fotos propias o autorizadas, con personas identificables solo cuando tienes permiso para usarlas.

2. Contenido no permitido

No solicites suplantacion, acoso, abuso, desnudez no consentida, menores en contextos sensibles, documentos privados o usos ilegales.

3. Paquetes creativos

Los estilos de AIdreamshoots deben usarse para retratos, perfiles, pareja, creador, belleza o albumes privados dentro de un uso responsable.

4. Revision

Podemos bloquear pedidos, rechazar instrucciones o retirar resultados que infrinjan esta politica.

5. Contacto

Escribe a support@aidreamshoots.eu para dudas de contenido.

settings.body:
1. Informacion que tratamos

AIdreamshoots usa el correo de cuenta, sesiones, selfies fuente, selecciones de paquete, instrucciones creativas, resultados generados, pedidos, suscripciones, movimientos de creditos, mensajes de soporte y senales tecnicas necesarias para seguridad y fiabilidad.

2. Uso de la informacion

Usamos esos datos para crear retratos solicitados, reservar y liquidar creditos, entregar albumes privados, resolver incidencias, prevenir abuso, mejorar guias de fotos fuente y mostrar el espacio privado correcto despues de iniciar sesion.

3. Fotos privadas

Las subidas y resultados quedan ligados a la cuenta del cliente en aidreamshoots.eu. No se venden como imagenes de stock ni se publican en galerias abiertas por defecto.

4. Pagos y conservacion

Los pagos se procesan con un proveedor conectado. Guardamos referencias de pedido, pago, reservas, devoluciones y suscripcion, no numeros completos de tarjeta. Algunos registros se conservan para soporte, seguridad, cumplimiento y acceso del cliente.

5. Opciones del cliente

Puedes pedir acceso, correccion, eliminacion o revision escribiendo a support@aidreamshoots.eu con el correo de la cuenta y el pedido afectado.

AIdreamshoots no envia productos por correo postal. El set terminado, las descargas y los movimientos de creditos viven dentro de la cuenta privada.

settings.body:
1. Sesion del estudio

AIdreamshoots usa cookies esenciales y almacenamiento local para mantener acceso, proteger el checkout, recordar el paquete elegido y conservar el avance de pedidos de fotos IA.

2. Senales de fiabilidad

Podemos leer datos tecnicos limitados para detectar fallos de carga, abuso, errores de pago y estado de generacion dentro del estudio.

3. Gestion del navegador

Puedes borrar o bloquear cookies desde tu navegador. Si bloqueas las esenciales, puede fallar el acceso a cuenta, carrito, pago, album o descarga.

4. Soporte

Para dudas sobre cookies del estudio escribe a support@aidreamshoots.eu.

seo.description: Politica de contenido de AIdreamshoots para selfies permitidos, instrucciones seguras, paquetes creativos y revision.
seo.keywords: AIdreamshoots,politica de contenido,fotos IA,creditos privados,album digital

settings.body:
1. Subidas permitidas

Sube fotos propias o autorizadas, con personas identificables solo cuando tienes permiso para usarlas.

2. Contenido no permitido

No solicites suplantacion, acoso, abuso, desnudez no consentida, menores en contextos sensibles, documentos privados o usos ilegales.

3. Paquetes creativos

Los estilos de AIdreamshoots deben usarse para retratos, perfiles, pareja, creador, belleza o albumes privados dentro de un uso responsable.

4. Revision

Podemos bloquear pedidos, rechazar instrucciones o retirar resultados que infrinjan esta politica.

5. Contacto

Escribe a support@aidreamshoots.eu para dudas de contenido.

settings.subtitle: Cookies para sesion, checkout, seguridad y continuidad de sets en AIdreamshoots.

settings.body:
1. Sesion del estudio

AIdreamshoots usa cookies esenciales y almacenamiento local para mantener acceso, proteger el checkout, recordar el paquete elegido y conservar el avance de pedidos de fotos IA.

2. Senales de fiabilidad

Podemos leer datos tecnicos limitados para detectar fallos de carga, abuso, errores de pago y estado de generacion dentro del estudio.

3. Gestion del navegador

Puedes borrar o bloquear cookies desde tu navegador. Si bloqueas las esenciales, puede fallar el acceso a cuenta, carrito, pago, album o descarga.

4. Soporte

Para dudas sobre cookies del estudio escribe a support@aidreamshoots.eu.

settings.title: Politica de privacidad
settings.subtitle: Como cuidamos cuentas, selfies fuente, creditos, pedidos y albumes privados.

settings.body:
1. Informacion que tratamos

AIdreamshoots usa el correo de cuenta, sesiones, selfies fuente, selecciones de paquete, instrucciones creativas, resultados generados, pedidos, suscripciones, movimientos de creditos, mensajes de soporte y senales tecnicas necesarias para seguridad y fiabilidad.

2. Uso de la informacion

Usamos esos datos para crear retratos solicitados, reservar y liquidar creditos, entregar albumes privados, resolver incidencias, prevenir abuso, mejorar guias de fotos fuente y mostrar el espacio privado correcto despues de iniciar sesion.

3. Fotos privadas

Las subidas y resultados quedan ligados a la cuenta del cliente en aidreamshoots.eu. No se venden como imagenes de stock ni se publican en galerias abiertas por defecto.

4. Pagos y conservacion

Los pagos se procesan con un proveedor conectado. Guardamos referencias de pedido, pago, reservas, devoluciones y suscripcion, no numeros completos de tarjeta. Algunos registros se conservan para soporte, seguridad, cumplimiento y acceso del cliente.

5. Opciones del cliente

Puedes pedir acceso, correccion, eliminacion o revision escribiendo a support@aidreamshoots.eu con el correo de la cuenta y el pedido afectado.

seo.description: Revisa como AIdreamshoots evalua creditos no usados, fallos tecnicos, pedidos entregados y solicitudes de reembolso.
seo.keywords: AIdreamshoots,politica de reembolsos,fotos IA,creditos privados,album digital

settings.body:
1. Elegibilidad

Puedes pedir revision de creditos comprados y no usados cuando no hayan sido reservados, consumidos ni asociados a una generacion completada.

2. Ventana de revision

Envia la solicitud con email de cuenta, pedido y motivo. Revisamos pago, historial de creditos y trabajos de fotos antes de decidir.

3. Creditos usados

Los creditos gastados en paquetes entregados normalmente no son reembolsables porque ya se usaron recursos de proveedor, almacenamiento y entrega.

4. Fallos tecnicos

Si un fallo de AIdreamshoots impide la entrega, soporte puede liberar creditos, reintentar el trabajo, entregar creditos de reemplazo o aprobar reembolso tras revision.

5. Contacto

Escribe a support@aidreamshoots.eu para facturacion o reembolsos.

settings.body:
1. Aceptacion

Al usar AIdreamshoots, crear cuenta, comprar creditos, subir fotos o iniciar un paquete aceptas estos terminos.

2. Uso permitido

Debes subir imagenes propias o con permiso, usar instrucciones licitas y evitar contenido que vulnere privacidad, identidad, propiedad intelectual o normas de seguridad.

3. Creditos y pedidos

Los creditos se muestran antes de generar. Pueden reservarse, gastarse, liberarse o devolverse segun el estado del pedido y la politica aplicable.

4. Resultados

Los albumes se entregan digitalmente en la cuenta privada. La calidad depende de fotos fuente, paquete, disponibilidad tecnica y reglas de proveedor.

5. Soporte

Para cuenta, pedidos o terminos, escribe a support@aidreamshoots.eu.

1. Subidas permitidas

Sube fotos propias o autorizadas, con personas identificables solo cuando tienes permiso para usarlas.

2. Contenido no permitido

No solicites suplantacion, acoso, abuso, desnudez no consentida, menores en contextos sensibles, documentos privados o usos ilegales.

3. Paquetes creativos

Los estilos de AIdreamshoots deben usarse para retratos, perfiles, pareja, creador, belleza o albumes privados dentro de un uso responsable.

4. Revision

settings.body:
1. Informacion que tratamos

AIdreamshoots usa el correo de cuenta, sesiones, selfies fuente, selecciones de paquete, instrucciones creativas, resultados generados, pedidos, suscripciones, movimientos de creditos, mensajes de soporte y senales tecnicas necesarias para seguridad y fiabilidad.

2. Uso de la informacion

Usamos esos datos para crear retratos solicitados, reservar y liquidar creditos, entregar albumes privados, resolver incidencias, prevenir abuso, mejorar guias de fotos fuente y mostrar el espacio privado correcto despues de iniciar sesion.

3. Fotos privadas

Las subidas y resultados quedan ligados a la cuenta del cliente en aidreamshoots.eu. No se venden como imagenes de stock ni se publican en galerias abiertas por defecto.

4. Pagos y conservacion

Los pagos se procesan con un proveedor conectado. Guardamos referencias de pedido, pago, reservas, devoluciones y suscripcion, no numeros completos de tarjeta. Algunos registros se conservan para soporte, seguridad, cumplimiento y acceso del cliente.

5. Opciones del cliente

Puedes pedir acceso, correccion, eliminacion o revision escribiendo a support@aidreamshoots.eu con el correo de la cuenta y el pedido afectado.

settings.body:
1. Elegibilidad

Puedes pedir revision de creditos comprados y no usados cuando no hayan sido reservados, consumidos ni asociados a una generacion completada.

2. Ventana de revision

Envia la solicitud con email de cuenta, pedido y motivo. Revisamos pago, historial de creditos y trabajos de fotos antes de decidir.

3. Creditos usados

Los creditos gastados en paquetes entregados normalmente no son reembolsables porque ya se usaron recursos de proveedor, almacenamiento y entrega.

4. Fallos tecnicos

Si un fallo de AIdreamshoots impide la entrega, soporte puede liberar creditos, reintentar el trabajo, entregar creditos de reemplazo o aprobar reembolso tras revision.

5. Contacto

Escribe a support@aidreamshoots.eu para facturacion o reembolsos.

seo.title: Politica de privacidad | AIdreamcapes
seo.description: AIdreamcapes resume privacidad para retratos fuente, rutas visuales, pagos, galerias y soporte de cuenta.
seo.keywords: AIdreamcapes,politica de privacidad,retratos de viaje,creditos de ruta,galeria privada

settings.body:
1. Informacion que tratamos

AIdreamcapes usa correo de cuenta, sesiones, fotos fuente, notas de ruta, paquete elegido, instrucciones creativas, resultados, pedidos, movimientos de creditos, mensajes de soporte y metadatos tecnicos para operar una galeria privada de viaje.

2. Uso de la informacion

Usamos esos datos para crear retratos de destino, mantener saldo y pedidos correctos, entregar galerias privadas, solucionar fallos, prevenir abuso y mejorar la orientacion de escena.

3. Fotos y rutas privadas

Las subidas y resultados permanecen asociados al sitio aidreamcapes.eu y a la cuenta iniciada. No se transfieren a otros escaparates ni se publican como muestras publicas por defecto.

4. Pagos y conservacion

Los pagos los procesa un proveedor conectado. Conservamos estados de pago, ordenes, suscripciones, reservas, reversiones y reembolsos cuando es necesario para soporte, cumplimiento y seguridad.

5. Opciones del cliente

Para acceso, eliminacion, correccion o privacidad, escribe a support@aidreamcapes.eu e incluye email de cuenta y datos del pedido.

settings.body:
1. Elegibilidad

Las solicitudes se revisan segun uso de creditos, estado de pago, suscripcion y entrega de la galeria.

2. Creditos reservados

Si una ruta falla por un problema tecnico, soporte puede liberar la reserva, repetir el trabajo o emitir creditos de reemplazo.

3. Creditos usados

Los creditos de galerias entregadas normalmente no se reembolsan porque el procesamiento de escena ya fue consumido.

4. Calidad de fotos fuente

Fotos borrosas, baja luz, permisos insuficientes o notas contradictorias pueden limitar la elegibilidad.

5. Contacto

Escribe a support@aidreamcapes.eu con email de cuenta, pedido y ruta afectada.

settings.body:
1. Aceptacion

Al usar AIdreamcapes, comprar creditos, subir fotos fuente o confirmar una ruta visual aceptas estos terminos.

2. Uso permitido

Debes tener derecho sobre las fotos que subes y no solicitar escenas que vulneren privacidad, derechos de terceros, seguridad o propiedad intelectual.

3. Creditos de ruta

Los costes se muestran antes de enviar una escena. Las reservas, gastos y devoluciones se reflejan en el historial de la cuenta.

4. Entrega

Las galerias se entregan digitalmente en el espacio privado. El resultado depende de fotos fuente, direccion de destino, notas y disponibilidad tecnica.

5. Contacto

Para revisar terminos, pedidos o cuenta, escribe a support@aidreamcapes.eu.

settings.body:

Sube retratos, referencias de vestuario, inspiracion de lugar o notas creativas sobre las que tengas derechos o permiso.

2. Contenido no permitido

No uses AIdreamcapes para suplantacion, acoso, abuso, desnudez no consentida, menores en contextos sensibles, documentos privados o fines ilegales.

3. Escenas de destino

Las rutas visuales deben describir ambientes, luz y narrativa sin reclamar ubicaciones reales falsas o permisos que no existen.

4. Revision

Podemos rechazar pedidos o retirar salidas que violen esta politica.

5. Contacto

Escribe a support@aidreamcapes.eu para revisar una solicitud.

settings.body: AIdreamcapes es una tienda en espanol para crear retratos de viaje, escenas de destino, albumes cinematicos y recuerdos privados con IA.
settings.tagline: Retratos de viaje con IA y albumes privados desde tus fotos.
settings.socialBody: Subidas privadas, creditos visibles, pago claro y entrega dentro de una sola cuenta.
settings.bottomLine: Creditos, generacion y galerias privadas en un solo espacio.

settings.body:
1. Informacion que tratamos

AIdreamcapes usa correo de cuenta, sesiones, fotos fuente, notas de ruta, paquete elegido, instrucciones creativas, resultados, pedidos, movimientos de creditos, mensajes de soporte y metadatos tecnicos para operar una galeria privada de viaje.

2. Uso de la informacion

Usamos esos datos para crear retratos de destino, mantener saldo y pedidos correctos, entregar galerias privadas, solucionar fallos, prevenir abuso y mejorar la orientacion de escena.

3. Fotos y rutas privadas

Las subidas y resultados permanecen asociados al sitio aidreamcapes.eu y a la cuenta iniciada. No se transfieren a otros escaparates ni se publican como muestras publicas por defecto.

4. Pagos y conservacion

Los pagos los procesa un proveedor conectado. Conservamos estados de pago, ordenes, suscripciones, reservas, reversiones y reembolsos cuando es necesario para soporte, cumplimiento y seguridad.

5. Opciones del cliente

Para acceso, eliminacion, correccion o privacidad, escribe a support@aidreamcapes.eu e incluye email de cuenta y datos del pedido.

4. Pagos y conservacion

Los pagos los procesa un proveedor conectado. Conservamos estados de pago, ordenes, suscripciones, reservas, reversiones y reembolsos cuando es necesario para soporte, cumplimiento y seguridad.

5. Opciones del cliente

Para acceso, eliminacion, correccion o privacidad, escribe a support@aidreamcapes.eu e incluye email de cuenta y datos del pedido.

settings.body:
1. Aceptacion

Al usar AIdreamcapes, comprar creditos, subir fotos fuente o confirmar una ruta visual aceptas estos terminos.

2. Uso permitido

Debes tener derecho sobre las fotos que subes y no solicitar escenas que vulneren privacidad, derechos de terceros, seguridad o propiedad intelectual.

3. Creditos de ruta

Los costes se muestran antes de enviar una escena. Las reservas, gastos y devoluciones se reflejan en el historial de la cuenta.

4. Entrega

Las galerias se entregan digitalmente en el espacio privado. El resultado depende de fotos fuente, direccion de destino, notas y disponibilidad tecnica.

5. Contacto

Para revisar terminos, pedidos o cuenta, escribe a support@aidreamcapes.eu.

settings.body:
1. Subidas permitidas

Sube retratos, referencias de vestuario, inspiracion de lugar o notas creativas sobre las que tengas derechos o permiso.

2. Contenido no permitido

No uses AIdreamcapes para suplantacion, acoso, abuso, desnudez no consentida, menores en contextos sensibles, documentos privados o fines ilegales.

3. Escenas de destino

Las rutas visuales deben describir ambientes, luz y narrativa sin reclamar ubicaciones reales falsas o permisos que no existen.

4. Revision

Podemos rechazar pedidos o retirar salidas que violen esta politica.

5. Contacto

Escribe a support@aidreamcapes.eu para revisar una solicitud.

settings.body:
1. Continuidad de ruta

AIdreamcapes usa cookies necesarias y almacenamiento local para reconocer la sesion, conservar elecciones de destino, proteger formularios y mantener pagos o galerias de viaje en curso.

2. Diagnostico operativo

Usamos senales tecnicas acotadas para revisar rendimiento, intentos de abuso, errores de ruta, estado de credito y disponibilidad de entrega.

3. Preferencias del cliente

La gestion se realiza desde el navegador. Al desactivar cookies esenciales, algunas rutas, pagos, accesos o galerias privadas pueden dejar de funcionar.

4. Contacto

Para consultas sobre cookies de AIdreamcapes escribe a support@aidreamcapes.eu.

settings.body:
1. Informacion que tratamos

AIdreamcapes usa correo de cuenta, sesiones, fotos fuente, notas de ruta, paquete elegido, instrucciones creativas, resultados, pedidos, movimientos de creditos, mensajes de soporte y metadatos tecnicos para operar una galeria privada de viaje.

2. Uso de la informacion

Usamos esos datos para crear retratos de destino, mantener saldo y pedidos correctos, entregar galerias privadas, solucionar fallos, prevenir abuso y mejorar la orientacion de escena.

3. Fotos y rutas privadas

Las subidas y resultados permanecen asociados al sitio aidreamcapes.eu y a la cuenta iniciada. No se transfieren a otros escaparates ni se publican como muestras publicas por defecto.

4. Pagos y conservacion

Los pagos los procesa un proveedor conectado. Conservamos estados de pago, ordenes, suscripciones, reservas, reversiones y reembolsos cuando es necesario para soporte, cumplimiento y seguridad.

5. Opciones del cliente

Para acceso, eliminacion, correccion o privacidad, escribe a support@aidreamcapes.eu e incluye email de cuenta y datos del pedido.

settings.body:
1. Elegibilidad

Las solicitudes se revisan segun uso de creditos, estado de pago, suscripcion y entrega de la galeria.

2. Creditos reservados

Si una ruta falla por un problema tecnico, soporte puede liberar la reserva, repetir el trabajo o emitir creditos de reemplazo.

Los creditos de galerias entregadas normalmente no se reembolsan porque el procesamiento de escena ya fue consumido.

Fotos borrosas, baja luz, permisos insuficientes o notas contradictorias pueden limitar la elegibilidad.

settings.body:
1. Entrega online

AIdreamcapes no gestiona envio postal. Cada retrato de viaje, reserva de creditos y archivo final queda asociado a la cuenta iniciada.

2. Acceso a la ruta

Usa el mismo correo para revisar escena, destino, progreso, resultados y descargas dentro de la galeria privada.

3. Ritmo de produccion

El tiempo puede cambiar por cola tecnica, detalle de la ruta, calidad de fotos fuente, cantidad de imagenes y revisiones automaticas.

4. Soporte de entrega

Si una ruta no aparece, escribe a support@aidreamcapes.eu con email de cuenta, nombre de paquete y contexto del destino.

prompt.rendered:
Create one private video for Image to Video using the selected video theme and 2 ordered frame images.

Video reference contract: treat the selected frame images as binding source resources, not loose inspiration or a generic theme hint.
Source images define who the visible people, products, wardrobe, props, and scene facts are.
User explicit direction wins over preset/theme wording for subject count, relationship, action, pose, camera transition, and story beat when it asks for a concrete scene.
Cast continuity is mandatory: every main person in the generated video must be the corresponding uploaded person from the selected frames, with the same broad face shape, hair color, hairstyle, skin tone, apparent age range, wardrobe color cues, and visual presence.
Preserve the visible subject count unless the user explicitly asks selected people to coexist in one scene, and preserve the main person or product, face shape, apparent age range, skin tone, hair color and hairstyle, wardrobe colors, props, background cues, lighting direction, and camera orientation from the selected frames.
Do not replace the source subject with a generic actor, do not change blonde hair to brunette or alter other defining visible traits, and do not move into an unrelated holiday, ceremonial, travel, studio, walking, or lifestyle template unless those resources are visible in the selected frames or explicitly requested by the user.
Theme direction may add only low-priority mood and camera texture after the frame resources and user direction are satisfied.
Mandatory user direction inside this source-resource boundary: 根据上传的图片，生成情侣接吻的视频

videoThemes.name: Cinematic Portrait Motion
videoThemes.headline: A refined moving portrait with subtle camera drift.
videoThemes.description: Turns a finished portrait into a realistic short profile clip with gentle movement.
videoThemes.prompt: Create one polished realistic short professional headshot video from the supplied image frame. Preserve the visible business portrait subject, office or studio portrait setting, wardrobe color, lighting direction, face-safe broad likeness cues, and clean headshot composition while adding subtle breathing motion, natural expression, soft parallax, and a slow cinematic push-in. Do not change into a market, mountain, pet, wedding, travel, cyberpunk, or empty landscape scene. No text, logos, UI, subtitles, watermarks, split screens, or collage layouts.

videoThemes.name: Social Profile Clip
videoThemes.headline: A crisp clip for profile headers and creator cards.
videoThemes.description: Adds clean expression movement and editorial light for social-ready profile moments.
videoThemes.prompt: Create one clean social profile video from the supplied fan portrait frame. Keep the visible stadium or fan-photo subject realistic and confident, preserve the outfit, pose, celebratory expression, and sports-fan atmosphere, and add a controlled camera slide with natural expression movement and crisp editorial lighting. Do not turn the frame into a mountain lake, empty landscape, market, pet scene, office headshot, or wedding. Keep the output uncluttered with no text overlays, logos, borders, UI, or watermarks.
